Author: Shinoyami
Name: Auto Raise Accept
Description: Automatically clicks Accept on FFXIV's incoming Raise dialog. Detection uses the game's active resurrection agent and does not depend on the raising player's name.
Changelog: Adds a configurable 0-60,000 ms delay before accepting a detected player Raise. The return-to-start timeout remains separate.

Author: Shinoyami
Name: MitPlan
Description: Displays editable job/role-specific mitigation reminders using default plans based on PF, Ikuya, and NAUR mitigation strategies where available.
Punchline: PF / Ikuya / NAUR mitigation timelines in-game.
Changelog: Unifies encounter timelines and mitigation callouts onto one phase-aware clock, linking every mitigation assignment to its timeline mechanic so anchor corrections move both together.

Author: Shinoyami
Name: MitPlan Recorder
Description: Records encounter casts and abilities, provides editable phase anchors and mitigation assignments, imports mitigation CSV files, and sends reviewed plans directly to MitPlan.
Punchline: Record encounter timelines and build MitPlan plans.
Changelog: Exports direct event references so recorded mitigation assignments use the same authoritative encounter clock as their timeline mechanics.

Author: attick, daemitus, Khayle, Shinoyami
Name: XIV Combo Expanded (Alt)
Description: Alternative XIV Combo Expanded build with a Sage option that replaces Dosis with Phlegma during detected raid burst windows and safely spends a second charge outside the final 20 seconds before the next tracked burst.
Punchline: XIV Combo Expanded with alternate Sage burst handling.
Changelog: Adds Sage Dosis-to-Phlegma burst handling with raid-buff detection, a first-burst fallback, a 6-yalm range check, and two-charge pooling for the next tracked burst.
